text.description: One clarifying question about the channels, in the language of the brief. Asking ends this call: the step waits for the answer.

options.description: Two to four short suggested answers, or null for a free answer.

question.description: Set only when the brief is genuinely ambiguous about the channels and questions_left is above 0; then plan and summary are null.

mode.description: single: one channel only. primary_fallback: one message per person, on the primary channel or else on the other. both: a message on every channel a person can be reached on.

primary.description: The channel of mode single and the primary channel of mode primary_fallback. For mode both, the channel that reaches more people (email on a tie).

rationale.description: One or two short sentences, in the language of the brief, naming the numbers or the request that decided the plan.

plan.description: The plan; null only when question is set.

summary.description: With a plan: two to four sentences for the marketer, in the language of the brief, in markdown (lists and bold allowed; no links, no HTML, no headings), saying how the audience is reached and why. Null only when question is set.
